0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The inattentive culinarian dearly hopes his international delivery hasn't been lost at sea.

25.original: Pick up the shipment for Aunt Tii's.

26.original: Deliver the shipment for Aunt Tii's to the inattentive culinarian.

48.original: You were on the ship that pulled into port just now, were you not? I've a favor to ask.

49.original: I'm expecting a shipment addressed to Aunt Tii's Tacos, but I fear it may have been unloaded on the southern pier by mistake. I'd be ever so grateful if you could speak with your crew for me.

50.original: I need to be getting back to open the shop, but if you do manage to find it, please bring it over. I'll see to it you're paid for the delivery, I promise!

51.original: A shipment for Aunt Tii's? Got it right here, o' course. Not sure what you were told, but all imports from Eorzea are unloaded on this side.

52.original: That culinarian makes some great tacos, but I'll be damned if he can pay attention to half the words I say to him...

53.original: His order's packed and ready in that crate there, but bugger me if it ain't heavy.

56.original: Right, that's the crate for Aunt Tii's. It's not far from here, if you don't mind carryin' it over.

57.original: What'd I tell you? Remember, lift with your legs!

58.original: You haven't found my shipment? Could you try asking around?

59.original: You found it! Thank the gods. I don't know what I would have done had my cookbooks been left on the dock back in Limsa Lominsa.

60.original: What luck that I could flag down such a hospitable deckhand.

61.original: Wait─what do you mean, you're not part of the crew!? I thought you came into port with my books!

62.original: Our taco stand gets a lot of tourists, so I thought I'd import some cookbooks from your culinary capital and brush up on foreign food culture. Who knows─one of these days I might just invent an Eorzean-style taco!

63.original: Anyway, my apologies for the misunderstanding! As payment, take these freshly made tacos, on the house!
